newsitem.title: USA: Goldman, Sachs consolidates two muni sales offices.
newsitem.headline: Goldman, Sachs consolidates two muni sales offices.

text.p: Goldman, Sachs & Co said Friday it consolidated the municipal sales forces for two of its regional offices, Boston and San Francisco, noting that no positions were cut.
"The reason for the consolidation is that it made sense, from the point of view of client service, to have the sales people closer to research and trading," said a spokesman for the firm.

The Boston office had two sales people, one of whom has left the firm, and would be replaced. The other individual was moved to New York City. In San Francisco, the sales people were shifted to the firm's Chicago office.
